Job Description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters


**͏**
-----

**Do**

1\. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software


* Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
* Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
* Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
* Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
* Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
* Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
* Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities
**͏**
-----

2\. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development


* Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
* Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
* Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
* Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
* Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
* Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
* Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
* Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
* Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
* Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders
**͏**
-----

3\. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution


* Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
* Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
* Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
* Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software\-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
* Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
* Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
* Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e\-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
* Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally
**͏**
-----

**Deliver**

**No.** **Performance Parameter** **Measure**  

1\. Continuous Integration, Deployment \& Monitoring of Software 100% error free on boarding \& implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan
  

2\. Quality \& CSAT On\-Time Delivery, Manage software, Troubleshoot queries, Customer experience, completion of assigned certifications for skill upgradation
  

3\. MIS \& Reporting 100% on time MIS \& report generation  

  

Mandatory Skills: Adobe Launch and Analytics .  

Experience: 5\-8 Years .

**About The Role**
* We’re looking for a strategic and domain\-driven Product Manager to lead the evolution of intelligent finance and grantmaking solutions within our Financials and Grantmaking pillar. In this role, your ability to think analytically, collaborate effectively, and drive outcomes will help modernize how social impact organizations manage funds, steward grants, and make data\-informed decisions. You’ll play a key role in advancing AI\-powered workflows and deeply connected financial capabilities that reduce administrative burden and expand what’s possible for purpose\-driven organizations.


**What You'll Do**
* Define and advance product vision by aligning intelligent finance and grantmaking solutions to long\-term strategic priorities, including AI\-driven innovation and connected financial ecosystems
* Translate domain expertise into impact by leveraging nonprofit accounting and grantmaking knowledge to shape clear, actionable product requirements
* Drive cross\-functional execution by partnering closely with engineering, design, and business stakeholders to deliver high\-quality, customer\-centered solutions
* Lead product delivery in agile environments by managing backlogs, writing user stories, and guiding development from concept through launch and iteration
* Elevate user experience by ensuring financial workflows and grantmaking capabilities are intuitive, efficient, and aligned to customer needs
* Identify opportunities for innovation by staying informed on industry trends, exploring enhancements, and supporting secure and scalable platform development
* Contribute to future\-ready solutions by engaging with emerging AI capabilities and collaborating on opportunities to incorporate advanced intelligence into the product suite.


**What You'll Bring**
* 5\+ years of product management experience, with a strong track record of delivering software products from concept through launch and iteration
* Knowledge of financial platforms and product lifecycle management, combined with expertise in Agile methodologies and backlog ownership
* Understanding of nonprofit accounting principles and grantmaking workflows, with the ability to translate complex business needs into product solutions
* Experience collaborating with engineering and design teams to deliver scalable, user\-focused products in fast\-paced environments
* Familiarity with emerging technologies, including AI or machine learning concepts, and interest in applying them to real\-world product innovation.

jobs.description:
**Overview**
 At Microsoft, we are building trusted, developer\-centric AI platforms that enable organizations to build, deploy, and operate AI systems at global scale. Microsoft Foundry provides a unified platform for experimentation, training, deployment, monitoring, and governance of AI workloads.
   

  

 As a
 **Product Manager II** 
 , you will own and deliver specific features or components within Azure AI Foundry and Azure Machine Learning. You will work closely with engineers and partner PMs to build platform capabilities that improve developer productivity and enable AI/ML workloads at scale.
   

  

 This role is focused on independently delivering well\-defined platform features, translating customer needs into clear requirements, and executing high\-quality features end\-to\-end within a scoped area. This role offers the opportunity to help define durable platform abstractions that unlock innovation for developers, data scientists, and ML engineers, while contributing to Microsoft’s long‑term AI platform direction.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities:**
* Own clearly scoped features or components within Azure AI Foundry / Azure ML and drive delivery from concept to release.
* Translate customer scenarios and feedback into detailed product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Work directly with engineering to ensure features are delivered on time, meet quality expectations, and align with defined requirements.
* Support feature prioritization and backlog management within your area, balancing customer needs, engineering constraints, and timelines.
* Collect and analyze customer feedback, telemetry, and usage signals to improve feature quality and usability.
* Collaborate with partner PMs and teams to ensure alignment on shared components and dependencies.
* Participate in customer discussions, internal reviews, and sprint rituals to build domain understanding and product intuition.
* Improve developer experience through incremental enhancements to APIs, SDKs, or workflows in your owned area.


**Qualifications**
**Must\-have**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.
* Experience (typically 2–5 years) in product management, software engineering, or related roles.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver features or components end\-to\-end in a product or service environment.
* Basic understanding of cloud services, distributed systems, or developer platforms.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly define requirements.
* Problem\-solving mindset with ability to work in structured, guidance\-driven environments.


**Preferred**
* Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) or developer\-facing products.
* Familiarity with APIs, SDKs, or service\-based architectures.
* Exposure to AI/ML or data\-related workloads.
* Experience using data or telemetry to evaluate feature usage and quality.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
 Entain India is the engineering and delivery powerhouse for Entain, one of the world's leading global sports and gaming groups. Established in Hyderabad in 2001, we've grown from a small tech hub into a dynamic force, delivering cutting\-edge software solutions and support services that power billions of transactions for millions of users worldwide.
   

  

 Our focus on quality at scale drives us to create innovative technology that supports Entain's mission to lead the change in global sports and gaming sector. At Entain India, we make the impossible possible, together.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a Product Manager, you will lead product strategy. This strategy will focus on our important products. You will work with our world\-class Product and Technology teams, which span across Australia, Germany, Croatia, India, and the USA.
   

  

 Reporting to the Product leader you will be part of the India Product Team, who work with the Technology \& Product and other important partners. Our team innovates quickly and works with our commercial partners and customers in a very Agile, environment. This is an opportunity to work in a close capacity with a team. The team consists of product managers, software engineers, business analysts, data engineers, and programme managers. Together, we guide simple and customer experiences. We do this in close partnership with customers.
   

  

 We are looking for an accomplished and experienced Technical Product Manager with a product mindset to join our team. You will guide the development of our backend platform that supports API and services, focusing on speed, security, and scalability. You will oversee the product discovery process and defining strategy. Additionally, it will involve managing OKRs while driving important subdomains like login/registration, CRM, payment systems, and compliance. These subdomains will support 100\+ labels across the US, UK, and LATAM, handling high transaction volumes.
   

  

 Are you ready to be part of our journey to be crowned the undisputed champions of the sports, permissible gaming, and interactive entertainment industry?
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Backend Platform Management: Lead the development and continuous improvement of backend APIs and services with a primary focus on speed, security, and scalability, ensuring agreement on user and our needs.
* Product Discovery: Conduct product discovery sessions, identify customer pain points, and translate those insights into applicable product roadmaps.
* Subdomain Ownership: Manage any of these subdomains for: Login and Registration, CRM, Payment \& Wallet Systems, Compliance \& Risk Management
* Collaboration \& Leadership: Partner with engineering, design, security, legal, compliance, and other product teams to define and prioritise the product roadmap and support important milestones.
* Market \& Competitive Analysis: Analyse market trends, competitors, and customer feedback to inform product strategy, identify new opportunities, and prioritise features.
* Continuous Improvement: Improve continuous improvements to the platform by applying data, user feedback, and industry best practices. Foster a culture of experimentation and iteration.
* OKR \& Strategy Management: Promote the setting, tracking, and achievement of OKRs for backend systems, ensuring these align with our goals and strategic goals.


**Qualifications**
* Experienced Product Manager with experience delivering excellent digital experiences, product strategy, architecture, cross\-team collaboration, and client engagement.
* Hold an engineering or MBA degree with experience in product management, requirement analysis, product marketing, and planning.
* Familiarity with Customer Service Management and Enterprise tools.
* Proficient in customer research, competitive analysis, product requirements, and messaging.
* People management, and partner engagement skills.
* Communicate complex technical concepts to a variety of audiences (written, verbal, and presentation).
* Create presentations, wireframes, and prototypes.
* Data\-driven with the important KPIs and present insights.
* Working with international, teams in a dynamic industry.
* Modelling, and writing skills with an understanding of product development processes, especially in Agile systems


**Additional Information**
 We know that signing top players requires a great starting package, and plenty of support to inspire your best. Join us, and a great compensation package is just the beginning. Working for us you can expect to receive great benefits like:
   

  

* Safe home pickup and home drop (Hyderabad Office Only)
* Group Mediclaim policy
* Group Critical Illness policy
* Communication \& Relocation allowance
* Annual Health check


 And outside of this, you'll have the chance to turn recognition from leaders and colleagues into amazing prizes. Join a winning team of talented people and be a part of an inclusive and supporting community where everyone is celebrated for being themselves.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Enterprise Knowledge Platform
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
* Experience in designing, building, and maintaining distributed systems or back\-end infrastructure.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
* Experience in information retrieval, search relevance, data indexing, or knowledge graphs
* Experience developing accessible technologies.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



The Enterprise Knowledge Platform (EKP) powers Google’s internal search engine and intranet. Our mission is to organize Google's internal knowledge and make it instantly accessible to all Googlers. We build the core infrastructure, knowledge graphs, and search capabilities that employees rely on daily to find code, documents, and tools.  

  

In this role, you will address large\-scale engineering challenges, leading to the design of highly scalable distributed systems and optimizing search relevance. You will accelerate productivity and innovation across all of Google.


The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, develop, and deploy scalable back\-end infrastructure and search ranking models for Google's internal search engine.
* Lead the architecture of complex distributed systems, optimizing for performance, indexing speed, and high availability.
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional partners (product manager, UX, and other engineering teams) to define product strategy and technical roadmaps.
* Provide technical leadership by driving engineering best practices, conducting design reviews, and mentoring junior engineers.
* Build and scale Google's internal search engine. Address complex distributed systems challenges and enhance search relevance, directly empowering Googlers worldwide to instantly find the information, code, and tools they need. Shape the core infrastructure of Google's internal knowledge ecosystem, driving productivity and innovation across the entire company.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

Our Technology centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of the company IT operating model, Tech centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. jobs.description:
**Company Description** 
 Eli Lilly and Company is a global medicines company focused on turning cutting\-edge science into therapies that improve lives around the world. Founded nearly 150 years ago by Colonel Eli Lilly, the company is driven by the vision to continuously enhance and advance its innovations: “Take what you find here and make it better and better.” Leveraging biotechnology, chemistry, and genetic medicine, Lilly’s scientists work urgently to address some of the most significant health challenges facing society today. The organization emphasizes responsible engagement with its communities and provides clear guidelines for interactions, while offering dedicated support channels for questions about its medicines.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Owner role at Eli Lilly and Company in Hyderabad is a full\-time, on\-site position responsible for end\-to\-end ownership of a defined business, product, or process area. This includes setting strategic direction, defining objectives, and translating them into actionable plans that align with company priorities. The Owner will coordinate day\-to\-day operations, monitor performance metrics, and drive continuous improvement across cross\-functional teams such as R\&D, manufacturing, quality, finance, and commercial. The role involves managing stakeholder expectations, identifying risks and opportunities, and ensuring compliance with internal policies and relevant industry regulations. The Owner will also be accountable for preparing business reviews, reporting progress to leadership, and fostering a culture of collaboration, transparency, and scientific and operational excellence.
   

**Qualifications**
* Proven ability to lead and own a business, product, or process area, including strategy setting, roadmap development, and execution oversight.
* Strong skills in project and program management, including planning, prioritization, risk management, and performance tracking.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with scientific, technical, operational, and commercial teams in a complex or regulated environment.
* Solid analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with the ability to interpret data, generate insights, and make evidence\-based decisions.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to present clearly to senior leadership.
* Background in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, life sciences, healthcare, or a related field is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, life sciences, engineering, or a related discipline; advanced degree (MBA, MS, PhD, or equivalent) is a plus.
* Demonstrated commitment to ethical conduct, quality, and compliance with industry standards and company policies.
* Ability to work on\-site in Hyderabad and collaborate effectively with global and local teams across time zones.

**Job Summary**
 The
 **Sr. Technical Program Manager, Supply Chain** 
 will be based in
 **Hyderabad, India** 
 and report to Supply Chain Program Management

* Develop and manage integrated program plans across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and external partners.
* Lead NPI builds (xVT, pilot, ramp, and/or post ramp qualifications) ensuring readiness across materials, test, tooling, and factory operations.
* Drive structured execution, clear milestones, and strong say\-do ratio across all stakeholders.

* Assess and advance automation readiness across manufacturing and test environments to improve throughput, quality, and scalability.
* Champion process improvements that simplify workflows and increase reliability.


**Risk, Problem Solving \& Intelligent Decision\-Making**

* Lead structured root cause and corrective action efforts when issues arise.
* Demonstrate resilience under pressure and adaptability in dynamic environments.
* Challenge the status quo and take intelligent risks that move the business forward.


**Communication \& Leadership**

* The ability to influence others and negotiate solutions in critical decisions.
* Communicate clearly and respectfully at all levels, fostering trust and alignment.
* Encourage curiosity by actively listening and incorporating diverse perspectives.
* Model integrity, respect, and accountability in all interactions.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, or related field (or equivalent experience).

* Master’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, or related discipline.
* PMP or equivalent certification.
* Experience with Project Management Tools (Project Charter, MS Project, Smartsheets, etc), and dashboards.
* Direct experience with domestic and offshore Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers
* Experience driving automation initiatives or digital manufacturing enablement.
* Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement experience.
* In\-depth understanding of NPI and Product Development processes
* Understanding of quality tools (8D, 5 Whys, QMS, COE) and the ability to drive root cause and corrective action activities.

* Lead through Collaboration, valuing diverse perspectives.
* Operate with strong Business Acumen, connecting execution to financial outcomes.
* Show Customer Focus by solving what matters most.
* Practice Integrity and Respect in every decision.
* Embrace Innovation and Intelligent Risk Taking to power what’s next.

 At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility\-scale power plants. jobs.title: Senior Data Acquisition Analyst
jobs.description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-247071 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Jun. 05, 2026 CATEGORY: Clinical
Job Description**ABOUT AMGEN**


Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

**Role Description:**


The Senior Data Acquisition Analyst is responsible for coordinating setup and management of external and non\-CRF clinical data integrations including central labs, imaging, IRT, eCOA, wearable devices, and API\-based integrations. This role supports end\-to\-end external data acquisition activities, vendor coordination, reconciliation processes, and study readiness while ensuring compliance with organizational standards and regulatory requirements.


This role collaborates with Data Delivery Leads, Database Design teams, vendors, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, and study teams to deliver scalable, standardized, and analytics\-ready external data solutions.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate setup and management of non\-CRF data integrations including central labs, IRT, imaging, wearable devices, and eCOA systems.
* Own assigned integrations end\-to\-end, ensuring successful delivery and alignment with business and study requirements.
* Drive standardization of integration approaches and downstream data consumption awareness.
* Develop and maintain vendor data transfer specifications, mapping documentation, and reconciliation requirements.
* Partner with vendors and cross\-functional teams to ensure timely and accurate delivery of external datasets.
* Review incoming vendor data for formatting, mapping, quality, and reconciliation discrepancies.
* Support API\-based integrations and external data transfer processes where applicable.
* Contribute to vendor oversight and execution of reconciliation activities for external data sources.
* Perform reconciliation activities between vendor datasets and CRF/EDC data.
* Collaborate with Database Design teams to align external data integrations with study database structures and standards.
* Troubleshoot vendor integration, data ingestion, and external data flow issues.
* Support study milestone planning and readiness activities related to external data delivery.
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation, quality tracking records, and integration deliverables.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance data integration efficiency.

**Accountabilities:**

* Support timely and accurate acquisition and integration of non\-CRF and external datasets.
* Assist with development and maintenance of vendor data transfer specifications and reconciliation activities.
* Collaborate with vendors and internal stakeholders to support study timelines and database readiness.
* Maintain operational efficiency, inspection readiness, and adherence to data acquisition standards and processes.

**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, computer science, health sciences, or related discipline and 5\-8 yrs Experience.
* Experience in clinical data management, vendor data integration, or clinical operations.
* Working knowledge of EDC systems, data transfer processes, and reconciliation activities.
* Familiarity with non\-CRF data sources such as labs, imaging, eCOA, IRT, or wearable data.
* Understanding of GCP, clinical trial workflows, and regulatory compliance requirements.

**Preferred Experience:**

* 5–7 years of experience in clinical data management, vendor data integration, or clinical operations.
* Experience collaborating with vendors and global study teams.
* Exposure to API integrations and external clinical data flows.
* Familiarity with centralized monitoring principles and reconciliation methodologies.

**Functional Competencies:**

* Strong understanding of external data structures, vendor data transfer specifications, and end\-to\-end workflows.
* Knowledge of reconciliation concepts with a digital and automation mindset.
* Working knowledge of CTMS, eTMF, EDC, and Microsoft Office tools.
* Understanding of external/vendor clinical data flows and reconciliation processes.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills.
* Familiarity with vendor oversight and reconciliation methodologies.
* Ability to identify data discrepancies and coordinate troubleshooting activities.
* Effective communication and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and timelines with moderate supervision.
* Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and data quality.
* Demonstrated initiative, learning agility, and continuous improvement mindset.
* Ability to independently manage competing priorities across multiple studies.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional problem solving and apply risk\-based decision making.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT**

 This role is grounded in strong business analyst practices and will be key in eliciting, documenting, refining, and validating business requirements for custom manufacturing applications. The role supports two related workstreams: finite scheduling applications, and AI\-centric operational applications such as Equipment Copilot and PlantPulse. The role partners with manufacturing SMEs, product owners, platform leads, developers, and external vendors to translate plant needs into clear requirements, inform backlog prioritization, coordinate testing, and support adoption of capabilities that replace spreadsheet\-driven and legacy workflows. The team uses AI\-assisted tools in day\-to\-day analysis, documentation, and delivery workflows, and the ideal candidate can connect plant operations needs with business process design, release readiness, and practical application delivery across the portfolio.

* Manage defect intake, business impact clarification, and resolution follow\-up with development teams and vendors to drive timely closure of open issues.
* Support release readiness activities including stakeholder alignment, access enablement, communications, production cutover coordination, and adoption planning.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual scheduling effort, improve data quality, standardize decision\-making, and retire legacy spreadsheet\-driven or manual planning workflows.

* Experience coordinating UAT, regression testing, defect management, and release readiness activities across business and technical teams.

* Working knowledge of manufacturing scheduling, planning, or operations workflows, including how production activities, equipment, and process steps are sequenced in a plant environment.
* Familiarity with enterprise integrations and data dependencies across manufacturing and business systems.
* Strong analytical, facilitation, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams while maintaining clear traceability from business requirements through testing and release readiness.


 Good\-to\-Have Skills
   

  

* Background supporting finite scheduling, production planning, plant execution, predictive maintenance, or related operations processes is preferred; direct experience with manufacturing scheduling software, including SAP PP/DS or similar platforms, is helpful. Experience with comparable manufacturing scheduling or operational platforms is a plus, but not required.
* Understanding of how manufacturing processes are sequenced, scheduled, or coordinated in a plant environment; previous MES or related execution\-system experience is a plus.
* Experience supporting manufacturing application scale\-out, site onboarding, or major ERP or upstream platform changes is a plus.
* Experience in biotech, pharma, or other regulated manufacturing environments.
* Experience producing training materials, job aids, and change\-management content for end users and site teams.


 Education and Professional Certifications
   

  

* Master's / Bachelor's degree and 9\-12 years of Information Systems, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, or related field experience

jobs.title: Director - Growth & GTM Operations
jobs.description:
**About 2070Health**


W Health has set up India’s first healthcare focused Venture Studio called 2070 Health \- an innovation platform that builds transformative healthcare companies from scratch by discovering disruptive opportunities in whitespaces. Distinct from the accelerator approach, our venture studio is closely involved in idea generation, day\-to\-day operations, and strategic decisions of growing the new business. Companies incubated in the last 24 months include Elevate Now, Nivaan Care, Reveal Healthtech and BabyMD and Everhope Oncology.

 **Role definition:**


The **Director – GTM \& Growth Operations** will work closely with the leadership team across Growth, Product, Sales, Operations, and Technology to drive business performance and execution. This role requires a highly adaptable operator who can own cross\-functional initiatives, solve business problems, improve operational efficiency, and scale growth levers across the customer lifecycle.

  

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across strategy and execution, moving seamlessly between growth initiatives, sales processes, stakeholder management, analytics, technology\-enabled problem solving, and business operations.

**Responsibilities:**

 **Business Operations \& Execution**

* Drive cross\-functional initiatives across Product, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Technology teams.
* Establish tracking mechanisms, operating cadences, and execution frameworks to ensure timely delivery of business priorities.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and proactively drive resolution across stakeholders
* Coordinate with internal and external teams to ensure business objectives are delivered efficiently

 **Go\-to\-Market (Execution)**

* Design and execute GTM strategies for growth initiatives with clear success metrics and tracking mechanisms.
* Collaborate with marketing, sales, and design teams to translate GTM plans into high impact acquisition campaigns and conversion\-focused journeys.

**Digital Marketing \& Acquisition**

* Plan, execute, and optimize performance marketing campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads (mandatory channels).
* Drive acquisition across paid search, paid social, and SEO, ensuring delivery against CPL, CPA, and ROAS targets.
* Work with tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and/or Google Tag Manager to track, measure, and improve performance.
* Continuously optimize funnels including landing pages, creatives, and retention journeys (email/SMS/WhatsApp) to improve conversion rates.
* Run A/B tests across campaigns, creatives, and landing pages to improve efficiency and scale.
* Own end\-to\-end performance marketing metrics including traffic, leads, conversions, CAC, and ROI.

 **Sales Enablement \& Revenue Operations**

* Partner closely with inside sales teams to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and funnel efficiency.
* Design and optimize sales processes, workflows, scripts, and operating playbooks.
* Analyze conversion data and identify opportunities to improve sales productivity and revenue performance.

 **Performance Tracking \& Insights**

* Build and manage dashboards to track CAC, CPL, ROAS, funnel conversion rates, and channel performance.
* Analyze campaign performance and derive actionable insights to improve efficiency and scale high\-performing channels.

 **Requirements**  

* 5–7 years of experience across Growth, GTM, Business Operations, Product, Revenue Operations, or Performance Marketing in high\-growth environments.
* MBA from a Tier\-1 institution is required, with preference given to candidates with an engineering background.
* Strong understanding of acquisition channels including Google and Meta ecosystems.
* Experience driving cross\-functional initiatives and stakeholder management.
* Demonstrated ability to operate in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments. Candidates from consumer technology, quick commerce, gaming, marketplace, D2C, healthcare, and high\-growth startup ecosystems will be particularly relevant.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled productivity and automation tools is preferred

  

**Benefits**  

* Flat, Performance\-Driven Culture: Thrive in a collaborative, non\-hierarchical environment where your impact is measured by results\-not titles or seniority.
* Entrepreneurial Exposure: Work directly alongside seasoned founders and business leaders, taking ventures from 0 to 1 across multiple cutting\-edge healthcare companies.
* Accelerated Learning \& Growth: Fast\-track your professional development as you solve high\-impact problems and help launch the next wave of healthcare innovation.

* Minimise Fraud losses by analysis of fraud trends, MIS, reviews,reporting and compliance
* Head Office Reporting and Stakeholder reporting for GBS supported countries
* Minimise fraud losses by recommending rules to detect real time fraud and also on pro\-active basis.

* Minimise Fraud losses by analysis of fraud trends, MIS, reviews,reporting and compliance Manage fraud risk, assisting businesses with implementing the 'best in class' tools \& processes to minimize fraud losses while maintaining and adhering to customer charter goals and objectives.

* Ensure the Fraud Risk Management framework is effectively embedded and communicated across Retail Customers segment.


 Identify industry best fraud risk infrastructure and management practices are tabled and are considered for adoption within the country

* Act quickly and decisively when any risk and control weakness becomes apparent and ensure they are addressed within an appropriate timeframe and escalated through the relevant committees
* Identify and track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to support strategy testing environment and daily operations.

**Governance**  

* Establish strong ties into the relevant business lines governance, risk and control committees to ensure adequate monitoring, tracking and governance of Fraud risk.
* Drive integration of Fraud Risk Framework and associated Policy and Standards into business lines and utilise for the ongoing governance process established within the Bank.

**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**  

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across the Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Lead the Fraud risk team to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: \[Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Financial Markets; Financial Crime Compliance; The Right Environment].
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Dyson IT**
 At Dyson, we demand the highest performance standards from the technologies we engineer. Our people expect the same from the technology that supports them.
   

  

 Global IT plays a critical role in enabling Dyson’s engineering teams to deliver world class innovation through scalable, reliable, and forward\-thinking digital platforms.
   

  

**Our RDD IT Team**
 The RDD IT function has end\-to\-end accountability for the design, delivery, and support of the systems that enable Dyson’s global research, engineering, and product development communities.
   

  

**This Includes**
* Engineering platforms such as PLM (Teamcenter), CAE, simulation, and digital engineering tooling
* Global product development systems and processes
* Delivery of transformation initiatives and operational IT services across multiple global sites


**The Role**
 The Technical Product Manager – PLM is responsible for defining, owning, and evolving technical products within the RDD IT landscape, with a particular focus on the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) stack.
   

  

 Operating within the RDD IT function, this role ensures that PLM product roadmaps are aligned to engineering needs and business priorities, translating complex requirements into structured plans for delivery. You will act as a key interface between engineering stakeholders, solution architects, and delivery teams, ensuring that solutions are robust, scalable, and aligned to industry best practices.
   

  

 You will work closely with internal teams and external partners to oversee the quality of delivery, drive continuous improvement across product and application lifecycles, and contribute to the long\-term evolution of Dyson’s engineering technology landscape.
   

  

**Principal Accountabilities**
 Product Strategy \& Roadmap
   

  

* Create and maintain an IT product development roadmap for PLM (Teamcenter) capabilities
* Ensure roadmaps reflect technical thought leadership and industry best practices
* Align product direction to engineering requirements and business priorities
* Continuously review and refine roadmap based on stakeholder input and delivery outcomes


 Stakeholder Management \& Business Partnership
   

  

* Act as an ambassador for Global IT across RDD and NPI stakeholder groups
* Engage with senior RDD stakeholders, engineers, solution architects, and business process owners
* Build strong working relationships across delivery, support, and engineering teams
* Ensure alignment between stakeholder needs and product direction


 Delivery Oversight \& Quality Assurance
   

  

* Work within the RDD IT delivery function to oversee quality of technical delivery
* Ensure solutions comply with defined standards, policies, and architectural direction
* Collaborate with delivery teams and external partners to ensure successful execution
* Support resolution of delivery challenges and ensure continuous improvement


 Platform Ownership \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Take joint accountability for the robustness and maturity of PLM platforms
* Support and improve product management and application delivery practices
* Identify opportunities to enhance system capabilities and user experience
* Drive continuous improvement across product lifecycle and service delivery


 Vendor \& Partner Management
   

  

* Work with external strategic partners to bring industry insight and best practice
* Collaborate with Legal and Procurement to maximise value from third\-party engagements
* Support development of long\-term platform capability and vendor strategy


 Technology Strategy \& Innovation
   

  

* Support architecture teams and strategic partners in shaping future platform direction
* Contribute to adoption of new technologies and industry trends within RDD IT
* Identify opportunities to improve capability through innovation and tooling evolution


 Professional Development
   

  

* Own and drive personal and professional development in line with Dyson frameworks
* Use internal development tools to assess capability and define growth objectives
* Continuously build technical and stakeholder management expertise


**Person Specification / Core Competencies**
 You must possess strong technical product management capability, with the ability to bridge engineering needs and IT delivery. You will demonstrate strong organisational skills, stakeholder engagement, and the ability to manage complexity in a fast\-paced engineering environment.
   

  

 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strong product management capability within technical or engineering environments
* Ability to translate complex requirements into structured product roadmaps
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
* Ability to prioritise and manage competing demands at pace
* Strong organisational and delivery focus


**Essential**
* Experience managing technical products within engineering or R\&D environments
* Strong experience with PLM platforms, particularly Siemens Teamcenter
* Experience managing change and enhancement within large\-scale engineering systems
* Experience working across delivery teams, architects, and business stakeholders
* Experience contributing to technical strategy and product direction


 Desirable
   

  

* Experience working within global, matrixed organisations
* Experience collaborating with external partners and vendors
* Exposure to engineering toolchains including simulation, CAE, or software development platforms

**Overview**
 Emmes Group: Building a better future for us all.
   

  

 Emmes Group is transforming the future of clinical research, bringing the promise of new medical discovery closer within reach for patients. Emmes Group was founded as Emmes more than 47 years ago, becoming one of the primary clinical research providers to the US government before expanding into public\-private partnerships and commercial biopharma. Emmes has built industry leading capabilities in cell and gene therapy, vaccines and infectious diseases, ophthalmology, rare diseases, and neuroscience.
   

  

 We believe the work we do will have a direct impact on patients’ lives and act accordingly. We strive to build a collaborative culture at the intersection of being a performance and people driven company. We’re looking for talented professionals eager to help advance clinical research as we work to embed innovation into the fabric of our company. If you share our motivations and passion in research, come join us!
   

  

**Primary Purpose**
 The Product Owner is responsible for defining and prioritizing the product backlog and ensuring the delivery of product increments that meet the desired outcomes. They collaborate closely with the development team and stakeholders to ensure alignment with business goals. The Product Owner supports the implementation of strategic objectives set by Software Development leaders and plays a key role in maximizing the product's value.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and prioritize the product backlog based on stakeholder feedback, business value, and strategic goals.
* Develop detailed user stories and acceptance criteria for product requirements, ensuring clarity and completeness to guide the development team in creating valuable features that meet end\-user needs.
* Collaborate proactively with the development team to ensure a shared understanding and alignment of product goals and requirements. Act as the voice of the customer, providing insights and guidance to the team throughout the development process.
* Plan and manage product increments and releases strategically, balancing team capacity, technical dependencies, and business priorities to deliver maximum value within set timelines.
* Facilitate product demos and reviews with internal and external stakeholders.
* Actively participate in agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, and retrospectives. Use these meetings to foster communication, identify challenges, and drive continuous improvement within the team.
* Provide clear, actionable guidance and clarification on product requirements to the development team, ensuring that all team members understand the 'why' behind each feature and how it contributes to the overall product vision.
* Act as a liaison between stakeholders and the development team to ensure effective communication and collaboration.
* Assist with secondary tasks such as communication, advertising, and the development of training materials and/or user guides as needed.
* Evangelize the product within and outside the organization.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a public health, clinical, science, technology, or related discipline.
* Incumbent typically will possess at least 5 years of experience working as part of a software development or implementation team in any role, 2 of which must be as a product manager or equivalent role. Years of experience requirements are not cumulative.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Experience with data reporting and analytics.
* Knowledge of key concepts related to software product management is required.
* Supervisory experience over other Product Managers is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Self\-motivated, proactive and detail oriented.
* Experience working in a Scrum team is preferred.
* CSPO and/or CSM certification is preferred.
* Experience with drawing tools and UX design is preferred.
* Experience working in a clinical research or health care domain is preferred.
* Experience conducting software demos and marketing presentations is preferred.
* A degree in public health, science, or computer related field is preferred.
* Working knowledge of browser debugging tools is preferred.

 CodeRabbit is an innovative research and development company focused on building extraordinarily productive human\-machine collaboration systems. Our primary goal is to create the next generation of Gen AI\-driven code reviewers: a symbiotic partnership between humans and advanced algorithms that significantly outperforms individual engineers. We combine language models with human ingenuity to push the boundaries of software development efficiency and quality.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We're hiring an AI\-native Product Manager to own CodeRabbit's local experiences: the CLI, IDE and editor integrations, plugins, and the skills that let developers shape how CodeRabbit works. This is where CodeRabbit shows up inside the developer's own loop, in the terminal and the editor, and increasingly inside the agents they code with. This is a high\-ownership IC role with a clear path to build and lead a team once you've settled in and proven impact.
   

  

 This is the most cutting\-edge surface we have. The ground moves monthly as the agentic coding ecosystem evolves, and we want a PM who's already living there: someone who uses these tools every day, has written their own skills, understands how agents actually call tools, and has strong instincts for where developer workflows are heading next.
   

  

 If you're AI\-pilled in the most practical sense, you don't just have opinions about agents, you build with them, this is your role.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
**CLI \& Local Review**
* Own the CodeRabbit CLI end to end: the experience of running reviews locally, before a PR ever opens, as a fast and natural part of the local dev loop
* Drive the pre\-commit and pre\-merge story so developers catch issues at the point of writing, not after
* Define what "instant, in\-flow feedback" looks like and relentlessly cut the latency and friction that gets in its way


**IDE \& Editor Integrations**
* Own the VS Code extension and the broader set of editor integrations (JetBrains, Cursor, and wherever developers actually write code)
* Surface findings, explanations, and one\-click fixes inline, where the code lives, rather than forcing a context switch
* Decide which editors and surfaces to invest in based on where our developers and the market are moving


**MCP \& Agent Workflows**
* Make CodeRabbit a first\-class participant in agentic coding loops: a tool that agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and others reach for as part of how they write and ship code
* Own the MCP integration and the design of how CodeRabbit exposes itself to agents, with the taste to get the tool surface right
* Anticipate where agent\-driven development is going and make sure CodeRabbit is built into that workflow, not bolted onto it


**Skills \& Extensibility**
* Own the skills and extensibility experience: how developers and organizations encode the way they want CodeRabbit to review, beyond our defaults
* Design the authoring experience for skills from the ground up, informed by having written and shipped skills yourself and understanding exactly how they work
* Build the foundation that turns CodeRabbit from a fixed reviewer into a platform people can shape to their own standards and stack


**Who You Are**
* 5\+ years of product management experience, ideally at a B2B SaaS or developer tools company
* AI\-pilled in practice: you use agentic coding tools every day, you've written your own skills, you understand MCP and how agents call tools, and you stay on the cutting edge of the AI dev ecosystem because you genuinely enjoy it
* Technically fluent. You can read and write code, you're at home in a terminal and an editor, and you can have detailed conversations with engineers without a translator
* You ship fast and iterate in the open, comfortable building in a space where the right answer changes month to month
* Comfortable with ambiguity; can move from fuzzy problem to clear spec without hand\-holding
* You write well and communicate precisely. PRDs and tickets you've written are things you're proud of
* Low ego, high ownership. You care about the outcome more than the credit


**Nice to Have**
* You've shipped CLI tools, IDE or editor extensions, or developer SDKs
* You've built or contributed to MCP servers, agent integrations, or agent\-native tooling
* You've published skills, plugins, or open\-source developer tools that people actually use
* You're active in the AI dev community and have a point of view on where agentic development is heading
* Prior experience at a developer tooling, DevOps, or code intelligence company


**What This Isn't**
 This isn't a stable, well\-specced roadmap you'll execute for a year. The surfaces you own change as fast as the AI dev ecosystem does, and a big part of the job is having the taste and conviction to make bets before the answer is obvious. If you need certainty and a fixed brief, this probably isn't your best fit right now.
   

  

 What it is: the most forward\-looking, highest\-upside product bet we're making, the place where CodeRabbit meets developers and their agents head\-on. We need someone who's excited to live on that edge.
   

  

**Who You'll Work With**
 You'll partner closely with our engineering leads (frontend, backend, SRE), the head of design, and our developer\-facing and growth teams. You'll report into Product leadership and work alongside a tight\-knit, high\-output India engineering team that moves fast and expects the same from product.
   

  

****Our Values****
* 🤝 Collaborative Humans: Prioritizing collective intelligence
* 🚀 Fearless Innovators: Turning obstacles into growth opportunities
* 💪 Persistent, Passionate Developers: Thriving on complex, long\-term challenges
* 🎯 Impact\-Driven Creators: Crafting intuitive tools for developers
* 🧠 Rapid Learners and Un\-learners: Adapting quickly in our fast\-paced technological world

jobs.description:
**About CodeRabbit**
 CodeRabbit is an innovative research and development company focused on building extraordinarily productive human\-machine collaboration systems. Our primary goal is to create the next generation of Gen AI\-driven code reviewers: a symbiotic partnership between humans and advanced algorithms that significantly outperforms individual engineers. We combine language models with human ingenuity to push the boundaries of software development efficiency and quality.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We're hiring a strong, hands\-on Product Manager to own the application side of the CodeRabbit Management Console, the surfaces every customer touches to set up, configure, control access to, and pay for CodeRabbit. This is a high\-ownership IC role with a clear path to build and lead a team once you've settled in and proven impact.
   

  

 You'll own organization settings, review configuration, role\-based access control, billing and subscriptions, and the onboarding experience. Getting these right is foundational to our move upmarket and to our growth.
   

  

 This isn't an AI\-glamour role. It's a complex, technically demanding, and deeply important one. We want someone who sees that clearly and is excited by it, not someone chasing the next shiny AI feature.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
**Console, Settings \& Configuration**
* Own the end\-to\-end product experience for organization\-level settings, team management, and review configuration
* Make complex configuration understandable and accessible for both technical admins and non\-technical buyers, without dumbing it down
* Work closely with engineering to define APIs, UI flows, and data models for configuration that scale across teams, repos, and deployment types


**Access Control: RBAC \& Custom Roles**
* Own the permission model end to end: define the roles, scopes, and capabilities that govern who can see and do what across settings, configuration, billing, and member management
* Ship custom roles so admins can define their own permission sets rather than being boxed into our defaults, the table\-stakes capability that unblocks larger, more security\-conscious buyers
* Get permission granularity and scoping right: org\-level vs. team\-level vs. repo\-level access, and the inheritance and override behavior between them
* Own audit logs and access trails, who changed what and when, as both an enterprise requirement and a pillar of our security and compliance posture
* Treat least\-privilege defaults, clear permission surfaces, and "no surprises" access behavior as core to the design, not afterthoughts


**Billing \& Subscription Management**
* Own the billing product: pricing display, plan management, seat\-based licensing, upgrades and downgrades, and invoicing
* Reduce friction in the purchase and upgrade path; design self\-serve flows with correct proration, and partner with Growth and Sales on conversion and expansion
* Own plan entitlements and feature gating, the mapping between what someone pays for and what they can actually use, kept consistent across the whole app
* Handle the subscription lifecycle edge cases that quietly break trust: seat reconciliation and true\-ups, renewals, failed payments and dunning, downgrades, and mid\-cycle changes
* Support enterprise purchasing: annual contracts, PO\-based and offline billing, tax and invoicing requirements
* Partner with Finance and Engineering on lifecycle correctness, and own the relationship with our billing infrastructure (Stripe, Chargebee, or similar)


**Onboarding \& Activation**
* Own the onboarding wizard and first\-run experience for new organizations and individual users
* Drive activation metrics: time\-to\-first\-review, time\-to\-team\-invite, and setup completion rates
* Identify and eliminate the top drop\-off points in the setup funnel


**Who You Are**
* 5\+ years of product management experience, ideally at a B2B SaaS or developer tools company
* Technically fluent. You can read code, understand APIs, and have detailed conversations with engineers without a translator
* Track record of owning complex, multi\-stakeholder product areas such as admin consoles, permissions/RBAC systems, or billing systems, where correctness and edge cases matter as much as the happy path
* Strong instincts for simplifying complex configuration and access experiences without dumbing them down
* Comfortable with ambiguity; can move from fuzzy problem to clear spec without hand\-holding
* You write well and communicate precisely. PRDs and tickets you've written are things you're proud of
* Low ego, high ownership. You care about the outcome more than the credit


**Nice to Have**
* Prior experience at a developer tooling, DevOps, or code intelligence company
* Direct experience with RBAC, permissions, or identity/access systems, designing role models, scopes, and audit logging
* Experience with billing infrastructure (Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and subscription lifecycle mechanics
* Familiarity with multi\-tenant SaaS architectures, and with audit/compliance requirements (SOC 2 and similar)
* Working knowledge of Git platforms (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, ADO) as a power user or PM
* You've worked with or alongside a small, high\-output engineering team and know how to match their pace


**What This Isn't**
 We'll be upfront: this role isn't primarily about building AI features. If what excites you most is prompt engineering, model evaluation, or shipping AI\-native UX, this probably isn't your best fit right now.
   

  

 What it is: one of the most important, highest\-leverage product bets we're making. The companies that win in developer tooling are the ones who nail the unglamorous stuff, setup, configuration, access control, billing, and trust. We need someone who genuinely believes that.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Role Summary:\-**
 The Product Owner is responsible for managing complex business requirements, driving solution discussions, and ensuring successful delivery of product capabilities across domains and systems.
   

  

 The role requires strong product thinking, insurance domain expertise, and the ability to operate effectively in AI\-enabled delivery environments. The Product Owner is expected to leverage AI\-assisted workflows to improve speed, quality, traceability, prioritization, and cross\-functional collaboration.
   

  

 The Product Owner is a member of the Product Management team of IDIT R\&D, responsible for managing requirements for complex features in the system. The candidate should be able to run workshops with domain managers, Product Managers, and customers to elicit requirements, present solution designs, and take requirements through to implementation.
   

  

**Pre\-requisites**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS/IT preferred) or equivalent qualification.
* MBA preferred.


**Experience**
* 6–9 years of relevant experience.
* Should have some technical experience before transitioning to a BA/Product role.
* Insurance or BFSI experience is a must.
* Prior knowledge of Core Insurance is a must.
* Experience of having worked in at least one implementation project.
* Led end\-to\-end requirements for at least 2 modules.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Product \& Requirement Ownership**
* Gather business requirements for medium to complex features and interfaces in the system (Contact/Policy, Claims/Accounting/Interfaces).
* Document requirements in SDS.
* Analyse and prioritize defects.
* Conduct requirement discussions with Product Managers, Domain Managers, and customers.
* Conduct walkthroughs of requirements with development and QA teams.
* Attend daily stand\-ups.
* Conduct User Forums.
* Conduct training sessions for junior members of the team.
* Work as a core representative to project teams as needed.
* Convert business requirements into Epics, Features, User Stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Drive end\-to\-end solution discussions across Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, and Delivery teams.
* Perform impact analysis across modules, systems, and business processes.
* Prioritize backlog items aligned to business outcomes and roadmap objectives.
* Ensure traceability from business requirements to implementation and validation.
* Support product roadmap execution and release planning.


**AI\-Enabled Responsibilities**
* Use AI tools to accelerate requirement analysis, documentation, prioritization, and workshop preparation.
* Use AI\-assisted techniques for: story generation, acceptance criteria generation, process mapping, impact analysis, test scenario generation, SQL/query generation, knowledge retrieval, and defect analysis.
* Validate AI\-generated outputs for correctness, feasibility, traceability, hallucinations, and bias.
* Use AI\-enabled insights to improve delivery efficiency and decision\-making.
* Contribute reusable prompts, templates, and AI\-assisted delivery assets.
* Drive adoption of AI\-enabled ways of working within teams.
* Apply responsible AI practices including governance, explainability, privacy, and human oversight.


**Mandatory Skills**
* Strong understanding of insurance processes and core insurance systems.
* Experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or Solution Design.
* Ability to manage complex cross\-functional requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies.
* Strong analytical and prioritization capabilities.
* Working knowledge of APIs, integrations, and enterprise systems.
* Excellent analytical skills and good design skills.
* Intermediate SQL and data modelling skills (mandatory).
* Understanding of SDLC and Agile concepts (mandatory).
* Very good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to document business requirements as user stories; break large epics into smaller features and stories and document them in SDS.
* Ability to conduct demos and walkthroughs with POs and business users.
* Techno\-functional and business solutioning capability.
* Ability to effectively leverage AI\-enabled delivery tools.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Experience with AI\-enabled delivery platforms and workflows.
* Exposure to prompt engineering and AI\-assisted analysis.
* Exposure to digital transformation initiatives.
* Exposure to Agentic AI concepts and orchestration\-based workflows.


**Key Characteristics**
* Outcome\-oriented mindset.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to balance speed with quality and governance.
* Systems thinking and cross\-domain understanding.
* Coaching and mentoring mindset.

**Job Description**
**Position Name** 
 : Product Owner\- 5G RAN
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore
   

  

**Exp** 
 : 8\- 14 years
   

  

 In our software development, we use methods and principles from Lean and Agile methodologies to create products that excels. Early customer and stakeholder interaction are a key element in our development process. We rely on team collective responsibility to complete all tasks according to a prioritized backlog.
   

  

 To expand our organization’s capability and responsiveness towards market needs we are looking for ambitious, intelligent, creative and inspiring individuals to join us. We provide a fun and challenging environment where you can grow and help to inspire your colleagues to further growth.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As OPO, you and your teams will work in one or more programs, to secure best possible time to market for the features in the program scope, with quality and in line with allocated capabilities and priorities. The OPO is responsible for the features, product improvements and TRs within products from a business and customer perspective, to maximize the product value.
   

  

* Secure that the feature scope is clear, and that the solution has the right scope, fit for the purpose.
* Communicate, coordinate and align feature scope, time and risks with both internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure that the Feature information is visible and transparent in the backlog.
* Secure the overall priorities in the Team backlog.
* Secure that the team knows what we do and why we do it to contribute to high team motivation.
* Secure that each feature is developed with good quality and promote a product level quality thinking.
* Develop business, value and technical understanding within the domain.


**You Will Bring**
 To take on this role you need to have a broad technical know\-how within software development combined with great people skills. This enables you to make legitimate prioritizations, identify risks and opportunities, as well as drive effective discussions within the development team. As OPO, you’ll be one of the leaders within the organization, hence it is important that you have a high interest in people, processes and technologies. You are passionate about Lean and Agile development and can articulate a clear vision that motivates others and inspires them to move in the same direction.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Technology, or a related field.
* Experience (8\+ years) within product development; as product owner, developer, team facilitator or similar roles.
* Good communication skills, be able to communicate with internal and external stakeholders at different levels.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**
**Product Manager:**
**Basic Summary:**
 We are seeking a forward\-thinking Product Manager to shape and advance the strategy, development, and evolution of our healthcare claims administration platform. In this role, you will manage the product lifecycle from concept through release, driving initiatives that address complex business challenges and deliver measurable value to customers. You will partner across the organization to define requirements, prioritize features, and ensure solutions are aligned with market trends, regulatory needs, and our long\-term product vision.
   

  

 The ideal candidate blends healthcare industry expertise with strong product management skills, bringing a data\-informed, customer\-centric approach to decision\-making. Experience leveraging AI\-enabled tools to accelerate requirements definition, backlog management, and analysis is a plus.
   

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**Product Strategy \& Roadmap Execution**
* Contribute to the product roadmap in partnership with senior product leadership, ensuring alignment with market needs, business priorities, and strategic objectives
* Identify and evaluate opportunities to enhance product competitiveness through emerging technologies, regulatory changes, or evolving customer needs
* Collaborate with engineering, design, and quality assurance teams to deliver features that meet scope, quality, and timeline commitments
* Develop clear, value\-driven epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria informed by market insights and stakeholder input
* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies and ensure delivery plans remain on track and adaptable to shifting priorities


**Market Insight \& Requirements Leadership**
* Gather and synthesize insights from customers, market research, and internal teams to inform product decision
* Translate complex business requirements into actionable development items, leveraging AI\-enabled tools for efficiency and consistency
* Prioritize backlog items based on business impact, market urgency, and customer value
* Partner with compliance teams to ensure product features meet healthcare regulations and security standards


**Cross\-Functional Influence \& Collaboration**
* Serve as a bridge between technical and non\-technical teams, ensuring shared understanding of product goals and constraints
* Work closely with UX/UI to advocate for user\-centered design and optimal user experiences
* Partner with customer success, support, and marketing to enable effective go\-to\-market strategies, adoption, and customer education
* Engage with leadership to provide visibility into progress, risks, and product performance metrics


**Product Performance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Analyse product usage data, KPIs, and customer feedback to identify enhancements and drive continuous optimization
* Support impact analysis for proposed changes and contribute to release planning to ensure seamless delivery
* Maintain awareness of industry shifts, competitive offerings, and payer/provider needs to inform future iterations and long\-term vision


**Minimum Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, or a related field 5\+ years of experience in product management, business analysis, or Agile product delivery
* Familiarity with healthcare or Healthtech domains, ideally in payer systems or claims processing
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams in a SaaS or software development environment
* Experience with Agile tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence) for backlog and requirements management
